from pathlib import Path
from datetime import datetime
from zoneinfo import ZoneInfo
import json,hashlib,re
e97=Path('reports/research/510300_industrial_last_period_native_title_source_v1')
prior=Path('reports/research/510300_industrial_same_title_original_carriers_v1')
e98=Path('reports/research/510300_industrial_last_period_government_month_headline_v1')
def now():return datetime.now(ZoneInfo('Asia/Shanghai')).isoformat()
def sha(p):return hashlib.sha256(Path(p).read_bytes()).hexdigest()
def readj(p):return json.loads(Path(p).read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
r=readj(e97/'固定原期标题查询首次取得回执.json')
assert r['status']=='REQUEST_FAILED_NO_RETRY' and r['error_type']=='SSLError'
result={'study_id':readj(e97/'protocol.json')['study_id'],'experiment_id':'E97','completed_at':now(),'status':'COMPLETED_SINGLE_NATIVE_TITLE_QUERY_SSL_EOF_FAILED_NO_RETRY_ROUTE_ENDED','actual_native_title_POST_attempts':1,'actual_HTTP_response_received':False,'error_type':r['error_type'],'error':r['error'],'real_original_report_GETs':0,'new_original_clock_support':0,'current_original_joint_source_qualified':78,'current_quantity_definition_qualified':79,'remaining_original_period':'2019M07','remaining_clock_status':'UNKNOWN_ONLY_DOCUMENT_DATE_NOT_PUBLICATION','fixed79_1711_1212_preserved':True,'conservative_known_members':1668,'complete_original_score_pools':1014,'full_source_gate_passed':False,'financial_status':'NOT_REGISTERED_NOT_RUN','new_linear_regressions':0,'new_simple_weighted_scores':0,'new_model_fits':0,'new_stock_labels':0,'new_accounts':0,'source_code_edits':0,'authentication':0,'raw_request_retries':0,'goal_achieved':False,'net_sharpe':'NOT_COMPUTED','finite_route_ended':True,'previous_complete_source_state':(prior/'result.json').as_posix()}
p=e97/'result.json';assert not p.exists();p.write_text(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
source=Path('reports/research/510300_industrial_native_official_search_source_v1/sources/2019M07.html')
full=re.sub(r'\s+','',source.read_text(encoding='utf-8-sig'))
assert '2.6%' in full
e98.mkdir(parents=True,exist_ok=True);assert not (e98/'protocol.json').exists(),'已有协议禁止重启'
query={'q':'2019年 7月份 工业企业 利润 同比增长2.6% 国家统计局','domains':['gov.cn']}
proto={'study_id':'510300_INDUSTRIAL_2019M07_GOVERNMENT_MONTH_HEADLINE_FULL_REPORT_SOURCE_V1','experiment_id':'E98','registered_at':now(),'basis':{'previous_source_state':(prior/'result.json').as_posix(),'sha256':sha(prior/'result.json'),'failed_native_title_route':(e97/'result.json').as_posix(),'own_original_monthly_headline_source':source.as_posix(),'original_source_sha256':sha(source)},'target_original_period':'2019M07','query_fixed_before_requests':query,'route_difference':'使用当期原报告自身7月份单月利润增长2.6%的新闻标题定位政府网常规统计快讯/数据页，不限定app、不重试原站内查询/相同链接；经济期和原数量不变。','budget':{'official_query':1,'different_original_report_first_GETs_max':1,'actual_same_report_image_first_GETs_max':6,'total_raw_GETs_max':7,'each_target_attempt_max':1,'authentication':0,'raw_GET_retries':0},'acceptance':'必须全国2019年1至7月原报告完整数量/财务效益原表/定义和自己的原公开钟；单月新闻只提供线索，摘要/后引/仅成文不能绑定目录原表，未知保留。只真实官方结果href，不猜文章ID，旧原不重GET。','fixed79_1711_1212_preserved':True,'first_vintage_and_scope_bridge_unknown_preserved':True,'new_stock_labels_budget':0,'new_financial_fits_budget':0,'new_linear_regressions_budget':0,'new_simple_weighted_scores_budget':0,'new_accounts_budget':0,'source_code_edits_budget':0,'financial_status':'NOT_REGISTERED_NOT_RUN','finite_stop':'一次官方查询/一个不同完整报告及最多六个原图结束仍缺公开钟则本路线结束，不轮询/改标题/重试；全源门成立才另题唯一固定非线性条件交互。','goal_achieved':False}
(e98/'protocol.json').write_text(json.dumps(proto,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2),encoding='utf-8')
